pr_body:

### What problem does this PR solve?
<!--

Please create an issue first to describe the problem.

There MUST be one line starting with "Issue Number:  " and

For more info, check https://pingcap.github.io/tidb-dev-guide/contribute-to-tidb/contribute-code.html#referring-to-an-issue.

-->

Issue Number: close #56760

Problem Summary:
We need some commands for operating log backup.

### What changed and how does it work?
We added such commands. See the linked issue for more details.

### Check List

Tests <!-- At least one of them must be included. -->

- [ ] Unit test
- [ ] Integration test
- [x] Manual test (add detailed scripts or steps below)
- [ ] No need to test
  > - [ ] I checked and no code files have been changed.
  > <!-- Or your custom  "No need to test" reasons -->

### Release note

<!-- compatibility change, improvement, bugfix, and new feature need a release note -->

Please refer to [Release Notes Language Style Guide](https://pingcap.github.io/tidb-dev-guide/contribute-to-tidb/release-notes-style-guide.html) to write a quality release note.

```release-note
Added three experimental commands for `br operator`: `list-migrations`(list compactions and truncated ts), `migrate-to`(remove compacted log files) and `base64ify`(convert storage url to base64, which is acceptable by `tikv-ctl`.)
```

issue_context.title: br/operator: add some debug commands to operate migrations / external storages.
issue_context.body:
## Enhancement
- **`migrate-to`** helps the user to migrate to a specified version.
- **`list-migrations`** helps the user to get what migrations here are.
- **`base64ify`** converts an external storage to base64 so they can be accepted by TiKV.
